name: Pong Game
description:
[b]Pong Game Template[/b]
A classic Pong game form with:
• Score display for both players
• Paddle and ball placeholders
• Basic game loop structure
• Two-player local multiplayer support
code:
' Pong Game Template
Dim score1 As Integer
Dim score2 As Integer
Dim ballVelocity As Vector2

Sub Form_Load()
    score1 = 0
    score2 = 0
    ResetBall()
End Sub

Sub ResetBall()
    ' Reset ball to center with random direction
    ballVelocity = Vector2(randf_range(-1, 1), randf_range(-0.5, 0.5)).normalized() * 300
End Sub

Sub Player1Scores()
    score1 = score1 + 1
    lblScore1.Text = str(score1)
    ResetBall()
End Sub

Sub Player2Scores()
    score2 = score2 + 1
    lblScore2.Text = str(score2)
    ResetBall()
End Sub
